Core instead says THREE SPELLCASTERS EACH RECOVER10RP,Action/120ft/Instantaneous/21RP. Resolve that literal amount/eligibility conflict explicitly,including native Tier versus rank,base versus modified cost and who selects the reference spell. Define exactly three versus up to three targets,self eligibility,current pool caps and overflow. The reference spell is not automatically cast or learned. Compare RP waivers,absorption and repeated group casting for conservation without silently changing the printed recovery; any anti-loop restriction is a NEW justified rule. No actual leyline topology or cosmology is inferred from the name.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: Choose3 actual RP-using spellcasters; each recovers cost of one Tier5-or-lower spell they can cast. Explicit L01-A current-book priority; Core flat10 and broader three-spellcaster wording retained as conflicting evidence. Tier means actual native generating spell rank0..5 for this NEW local completion, never characterlevel or paidRP.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_targets: Exactly three distinct willing living perceived beneficiaries with real independently acquired RP pools, within120feet and line of effect; self allowed once. Oracle RC-only is ineligible. Each must have at least one actual acquired operational spell route of rank0..5 and unused Leyline receipt entitlement. Each selects their reference at declaration; absent choice means no legal declaration. Creature names do not grant pools, repertoire, custody or cosmology.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_reference: Choose one genuinely possessed legal learned/prepared/class/native temporary route with an ordinary BASE RP-price interface and actual native rank0..5. Acquisition/preparation must exist, but current depleted funds, spent Action, Dissonance/Nullification or other temporary use restriction does not remove a possessed reference; record such restriction separately. Select printed actual native base RP price, including a class card’s true replacement base, before ANY optional extra, protectedprincipal, discount, waiver, Nexus, Matrix, Influence, Dampening or strain. Rank0base0 is allowed but yields0; no-interface charge-only/RC reference is ineligible. Snapshot that source and base at commitment, revalidate actual identity/grant at resolution; reference is never cast, learned, countered, paid or exhausted.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_award: NEW explicit anti-repeat receipt limit, selected L04-B: one Leyline Flow receipt attempt per actual identity across all casters/classes/copies since that identity’s actual beneficial completed long rest. This is new spell-local authorship, not inherited Well law. At legal cast commitment atomically reserve/consume each of the three actual receipt uses, even if countered or later prevented; existing uses cannot be borrowed/reset by replacement, suppression, copying or Matrix. No separate caster daily cap. At resolution independently recheck each original recipient living/consent/range/line/grant. Each remaining branch credits its snapped base once, capped at that pool maximum; lost/blocked/overfull branch is wasted, no retarget/refund or shared reservoir. Valid siblings still resolve. Self recovery happens after real21cost, not financing it retroactively.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_consequences: A native paid rank5-reference cast can recover30for21 group delta+9; this is an explicit useful finite creation, not conservation. Matrix may waive the21but does not erase intrinsic recovery or receipt limit; repeated same recipients are ineligible before any second payment. Different actual unused recipients can benefit; eventual real beneficial long rests refresh only their own source-qualified ledger. Bound rest/cadence/strain and actual identities remain necessary; no infinite-loop or balance claim follows. Shield can intercept a recipient branch, spending that Leyline receipt while only actually paid root base funds bounded Shield recovery. Furnace/Conduit remain distinct transactions. Name grants no actual leyline access/map.
